rotating_tips: #group @user1 @user2 — create groups with members in one command
@user1 @user2 or #group1 #group2 — send to multiple chats in one message
@ai your question — PointChat AI (only your private AI thread)
Use the location button in the composer to share GPS
/setting — open your settings (seen receipts, notify when seen)
Voice notes: ±1s buttons and waveform tap to seek
Profile > Seen & read receipts controls read status for all chats
Type @ to see people; type / for slash commands
ai_knowledge: PointChat supports DMs (@username), groups (#groupname), voice messages, photos/files, and location sharing via the location button in the composer. /newbot Name opens creating a custom bot. @ai talks to PointChat AI in the user's private self-chat thread. Custom bots reply when messaged. Slash commands: /setting, /newbot. Seen/read controls live in Profile > Seen & read receipts, including notify when someone sees your message. AI responses do not use web search or Google grounding (text-only model).
